description: Hand-labelled reviews for evaluating triage. Written for this project, separate from the demo dataset, and deliberately phrased differently from it.

cases.text: Opened it this morning and it closed straight away. Every single time.

Works, but it takes about eight seconds to load every time.

Muy lenta en mi teléfono, tarda en mostrar las tareas.
